facts.text: The host application reaches the controller over USB serial at 115200 baud
SerialThread opens the port with pyserial, a 0.1 s read timeout and a 0.5 s write timeout
A string command is framed as 0x55, 0xAA, the UTF-8 command text and a newline
A binary command is prefixed with 0x02 and its last byte is a CRC-8-CCITT of the preceding bytes
The 24-byte status packet starts with cmd_id and status and carries X, Y, Z and W as big-endian int32 positions in bytes 2 to 17
The host parses the 24-byte packet as X/Y/Z/W big-endian int32 and treats status 1 as moving
MOVETO_X, MOVETO_Y and MOVETO_Z are command ids 6, 7 and 8, and SET_AXIS_DISABLE_ENABLE is 32
SET_PORT_ILLUMINATION is command id 37 and TURN_OFF_ALL_PORTS is command id 39
An absolute move carries a signed int32 microstep target in payload bytes 2 to 5, converted from micrometres as position / 1000 / mm_per_step
The X travel is -10 to 115000 micrometres and the Y travel is -10 to 76000 micrometres
The five illumination ports D1 to D5 have port indexes 0 to 4
The illumination control is a 0 to 100 percent slider and the host scales a percentage to a 0 to 65535 DAC value
SET_PORT_ILLUMINATION writes the port, a 16-bit intensity and the on/off byte
SET_AXIS_DISABLE_ENABLE with byte 3 equal to 0 de-energises the addressed axis
TURN_OFF_ALL_PORTS switches every illumination port off
